description: Links a Google Analytics 4 property to one Search Console property in Organiq (the same setting as the panel's "Integrações" block): ga4PropertyId is the numeric id from list_ga4_properties ("123456789" or "properties/123456789"); null unlinks. Returns the property settings. When the value changes, the GA4 data already synced from the previous property is deleted and the next daily sync rebuilds the history from the new one (Search Console data is untouched); get_ai_traffic answers after that sync. Needs the write scope (mcp:write). Use it when check_connection lists no_ga4 or the user asks to connect GA4. Guide: https://organiqgeo.com/connect/ga4. / Liga a propriedade GA4 à propriedade do Search Console; trocar apaga o GA4 já sincronizado e o sync refaz.

ga4PropertyId.description: Numeric GA4 property id ("123456789" or "properties/123456789"), from list_ga4_properties; null unlinks.

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. The value "demo" selects a demonstration site with fictional data: it works without signing in and is read-only. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id; "demo" é um site de demonstração com dados fictícios, sem login e só leitura.

name: set_ga4_property
title: Link a GA4 property
